integrity: The statement, proof, fractional LP and seven exact witnesses are contained in this package. The 64 four-vertex graphs are checked by included standalone source, but the general theorem depends on analytic sign averaging and finite LP duality. Independent scientific audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real 2-convexified combinatorial norms with all singletons; the theorem determines the minimal Hilbert distortion and a canonical optimizer, not all optimal forms or distances between unrelated spaces. Perfectness application invokes the published strong perfect graph theorem. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a possibility.
title: Fractional clique covers give the exact Hilbert distance of finite quadratic combinatorial spaces
